input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer.
input.rationale: Once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, off-site where practicable via an independent auditor under confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct access to our systems or unrelated data (22.2). Exactly our preferred position.

input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Professional/workmanlike warranty plus a 90-day Deliverable conformance warranty and term-long hosted Services conformance, with re-performance/repair/replace and a termination-and-refund backstop (19.4), plus compliance-with-law and no-malicious-code warranties (19.3). The disclaimer in 19.5 expressly does not limit the express warranties, so it does not swallow them.
